entities.name: Mirtiin Rebellion
entities.description: A 4185 AR uprising on Stahaan over King Myrrax's experiment to civilize goblins.

entities.name: Stahaan
entities.description: An island of the Domains of Dominaria, a minotaur matriarchy.

entities.name: Mirtiin
entities.description: A minotaur tribe whose clans came under Stahaan rule.

entities.name: King Myrrax
entities.description: Visionary minotaur king of the Mirtiin who sought to civilize goblins.

entities.name: Scaraya
entities.description: Progressive clan leader who believed fear caused goblin violence.

entities.name: Istini Ayesh ni Hata Kan
entities.description: Onean survivor who taught goblins meditation.

entities.name: Tlik
entities.description: Goblin star pupil of Ayesh who kept discipline.

entities.name: Betalem
entities.description: Priestess of Stahaan who opposed the experiment.

entities.name: Zhanrax
entities.description: Independent minotaur who freed Ayesh and Tlik.

entities.name: Gynnalem
entities.description: Stahaan matriarch who executed Myrrax and Tekrax.

entities.name: Cimmaraya
entities.description: Figure whose teachings survived in secret.

entities.name: Fall of Oneah
entities.description: Destruction of Oneah by goblins twenty years earlier.

events.summary: Myrrax and Scaraya begin drugging goblins and training them to confront fear.
events.quote: they began drugging goblins to dull their instincts and trained them to confront fear directly.

events.summary: Ayesh arrives and becomes a dedicated instructor to the goblins.
events.quote: she became a dedicated instructor to the goblins, finding a surprising degree of success.

events.summary: Betalem and traditionalists oppose the experiment, dividing the minotaurs.
events.quote: Some minotaurs supported the king's idealistic vision, while others rallied behind Betalem

events.summary: Mirtiin plunges into civil war drawing in Stahaan; most goblins revert to wildness.
events.quote: Mirtiin plunged into a civil war that drew in forces from Stahaan.

events.summary: Zhanrax frees Ayesh and Tlik, who flee.
events.quote: Ayesh and Tlik were freed by the stubbornly independent Zhanrax

events.summary: Matriarch Gynnalem executes Myrrax and Tekrax.
events.quote: while King Myrrax and his captain Tekrax were executed by matriarch Gynnalem to spare the rest of their people.

events.summary: Mirtiin falls under Stahaan rule, though rebellious ambitions grow in secret.
events.quote: the aftermath of the rebellion left Mirtiin under the dominion of rigidly orthodox Stahaan rulers

relations.quote: King Myrrax and his captain Tekrax were executed by matriarch Gynnalem
others rallied behind Betalem, fearing the corruption of their traditions.
